limitations: The deposited compact arrays are MD-derived snapshots, not full classical-MD trajectories.
The coordinate archives contain QM/MM reaction paths and were not required for these summaries.
Crystal disorder supports conformational heterogeneity but is not itself an MD observable.
The reported barriers are single-point QM/MM potential-energy differences, not solution free-energy barriers.
The simple bootstrap treats snapshots as independent and may underestimate uncertainty if the MD-derived samples are correlated.
